items.Description: Even in death, the mouth of the notorious pirate Bart Sidious IV is curled into a malicious grin.

items.Name: Human Head
items.Description: It takes all of your constitution not to gag at the sight of this human head. It is horribly damaged by the claws and teeth of trolls. The eyes, still intact, give away the fear of the victim before death. The head is otherwise too mangled to be recognizable.

items.Name: Vannik's Head
items.Description: Although he is clearly dead, the eyes of the conniving pirate Vannik the Red still give you the impression that he is plotting something.

items.Name: Helm of the Antipaladin
items.Description: The black symbolizes the heart of its owner. The red symbolizes the blood of innocents. This helmet once shone with the glory of Valenur, but is now twisted with the corruption of the Fallen.

items.Description: When King Rand IV of Dinsmark invaded the Ikido province of Akaida, he had a series of these helmets created by his armor smiths. items.Name: Helmet of Blindness and Deafness
items.Description: The wearer of this helmet is struck blind and deaf.

items.Name: Lesser Mask of Intellect
items.Description: Woven round the brim of this helm is a light cord with a small gem set so that it rests upon the forehead of the wearer.  The magic of the headband has the power to dramatically sharpen the wearer's intellect.

items.Description: At first glance, this appears to be nothing more than a regular helmet. There is obviously some kind of magic at work here, the source of which is unknow…

items.Description: This helmet is said to have once belonged to Perius Fell, a huge barbarian king from the faraway world of Narciss. By all accounts, Perius is still alive and dominating the tribes of Ardor, so it is not known how this helmet came to be here.

items.Description: One of the few possessions Evanine still has from Akaida, the soft, supple leather of this armor still looks new. There is powerful magic enhancing its durability, but the leather itself is also unique. Neither Evanine nor expert armorers in Britannica can identify it.

items.Name: Evanine's Bow
items.Description: This bow is a family heirloom that was passed to Evanine from her father. The dark and ivory colors of the wood do not appear to be the result of paint, and the shine of the wood never seems to dull. Even when the bow is dropped onto solid rock, the wood neither cracks nor splin…

items.Description: Evanine's mother gave her this blade when she was little and told her it was from Alyssius, her birthplace. The metal is smooth and glows with a soft light. The ivory handle is too hot to hold, but Evanine claims it feels soft and comfortable in her hands.

items.Description:
This gold ring was a gift from Evanine's
mother on their last birthday together. The band is simple yet attractive and elegant, focusing on the natural beauty of the gold and gemstone rather than an elaborate design.

items.Name: Romadon Plate
items.Description: This half-plate is the armor of choice for Romadon warriors, providing protection and freedom of movement in the arms to swing a weapon. Montador has added additional enhancements to the armor, but he won't divulge the source.

items.Name: Romadon Axe
items.Description: Romadon axes have a wicked point on the end of their blades to inflict further damage on opponents. Judging by the gleam of the metal and the sharpness of the blade's edge, it is obvious that Montador spends much of his time sharpening it.

items.Name: Romadon Belt
items.Description: In addition to providing protection from blows, this plated belt is also imbued with a magic that drains some of the wearer's life force but provides rapid healing. For hardy warriors who are in constant combat like the Romadons, the trade is well worth it.

items.Description: Most of the original copper coating on this key has worn off from old age and much use. There is a faint smell of formaldehyde on it, as if its owner handled a lot of the preservative.

items.Description:

items.Description:

items.Name: Alehouse Room Key
items.Description: This key opens the door to a bedroom on the upper floor of Sirion's Alehouse tavern and inn.

items.Name: Amridell Gate Key
items.Description: This key once belonged to the genie of Amridell and will open the gate to the lower levels of the ruins.

items.Name: Amridell Key
items.Description: The brass on this key has faded from countless years resting beneath layers of dust and cobwebs. There is no indication as to what kind of lock it opens.

items.Name: Argautha's Key
items.Description: You obtained this heavy gold key from Argautha, the great red dragon that guards the entrance to the Temple of Valienna in the Western March.

items.Name: Azorite Prison Key
items.Description: According to the journal of Colmar, an Azorite Warlord, this intricate brass key opens the door to an Azorite prison. The lock is likely unpickable.

items.Name: Azorite Warden Key
items.Description: This simple copper key belongs to the warden of the Azorite prison.

items.Name: Barracks Chest Key
items.Description: This key opens the spare chest in City Guard Barracks One, located in the Government District.

items.Name: Barracks One Key
items.Description: This simple key opens the door to the Barracks One of the Edinburg City Guard.

items.Name: Thieve's Guild Key
items.Description: This key opens the door to the Bloody Dagger's hideout.

items.Name: Boat Club Cloakroom Key
items.Description: This key opens the door to the Boat Club cloakroom.

items.Name: Cultist Key
items.Description: You recovered this key from a powerful master doppelganger. It likely opens a door that leads further into Azurik Hall.

items.Name: Delver's Lodge Room Key
items.Description: This key opens the door to a bedroom on the upper floor of Delver's Lodge in Hamlin.

items.Name: Brass Key
items.Description: This intricate brass key looks like it was made to fit an unusually complex lock. The lock is likely unpickable.

items.Name: Firmog's Key
items.Description: It is almost impossible to hold this scorching-hot key in your hands. You wonder what kind of infernal magic it is imbued with.

items.Name: Old Key
items.Description: The paint has long since worn off this old, simple metal key. It likely opens a door in an equally old neighborhood.

items.Name: Bedime Estate Key
items.Description: This ornate key opens the doors to the Bedime Estate in the Noble's District.

items.Name: Golden Keg Room Key
items.Description: This key opens the door to a bedroom on the upper floor of Southport's Golden Keg inn.

items.Name: Goldfoot Estate Key
items.Description: The Bloody Daggers 'procured' this key by unknown means to open the backdoor of the Goldfoot Estate. The Goldfoots live in the Noble's District.

items.Name: Metal Key
items.Description: This simple-looking key taken off Chief Golgash likely opens a door in his cave lair.

items.Name: Thieve's Guild Chest Key
items.Description: This key opens a spare chest in the lower level of the Thieves Guild.

items.Name: Amemnus' Key
items.Description: You obtained this key from Amemnus in Limbo. It will open the door to the next challenge.

items.Name: Hazel's Key
items.Description: You obtained this key from Hazel's test in Limbo. It should open the door to the next challenge.

items.Name: Lyperius' Key
items.Description: This key was given to you by Lyperius in Limbo. It should open the door to the next challenge.

items.Name: Melkelor's Key
items.Description: This key was given to you by a genie in Limbo. It will open the door to the second test.

items.Name: Seigfried's Key
items.Description: This key was given to you by Seigfried in Limbo. It should open the door to the next challenge.

items.Name: Lazy Lion Bedroom Key
items.Description: This key opens the door to one of the upper floor bedrooms of the Lazy Lion.

items.Name: Dancing Mermaid Key
items.Description: This key opens the door to the lower level of the Dancing Mermaid brothel in Southport.

items.Name: Merry on Tap Room Key
items.Description: This key opens the door to a bedroom on the upper floor of Sirion's Merry on Tap tavern and inn.

items.Name: Castle Mordred Key
items.Description: This old key has seen much use in its time, but its purpose is not immediately apparent.

items.Name: Bloodstained Key
items.Description: This bloodstained key was found on the body of the vampire Asheara.

items.Name: Mug and Hearth Room Key
items.Description: This key opens the door to a bedroom on the upper floor of the Mug and Hearth in Oakwood.

items.Name: Regis Estate Key
items.Description: This key was given to you by Loxaus Black, an unsavory nobleman in the Peacock's Feather brothel in Sirion. It opens the door to the home of Alistaris Regis in the Viscount Estates.

items.Name: Sewer Door Key
items.Description: This rusty key opens a portcullis in the abandoned sewers under the Edinburg  Slums.

items.Name: Shadowmaster Key
items.Description: You found this key on the corpse of the Shadowmaster. You're not sure what it opens, but its target is likely somewhere in the Shadow Weaver lair.

items.Name: Intricate Key
items.Description: This intricate copper key looks like it was made to fit an unusually complex lock. The lock is likely unpickable.

items.Name: Bone Key
items.Description: This gruesome key is made from the polished bone of a long dead victim of the Azuriks.

items.Name: Training Barracks Key
items.Description: This simple key opens the door to the Training Barracks of the Edinburg City  Guard.

items.Name: Typhander's Key
items.Description: This simple brass key opens the door to Typhander's home in Oakwood.

items.Name: Vannik's Key
items.Description: This simple gold key was taken from Vannik the Red. It likely opens a door to a room in his lair.

items.Name: Viscount Club Key
items.Description: This brass key opens the doors to the backrooms of the Viscount Club in Sirion.

items.Name: Geography of Arterra
items.Description:
Arterra is divided into three large land masses, although the exact amount of unexplored land remaining is unknown.

  The western continent of Arterra is Alaron, although most refer to its two large territories on their own: Britannica and Istar. Britannica is a well-populate…

items.Name: The Azurik Monarchy I
items.Description: Asra Azurik and Sindalar Azurik were a pair of powerful sorcerers who ruled a small kingdom called Merador in the deepest south of Istar over a century ago at the time of this writing. They were a king and queen whose tyranny was well-known even then. The people of Merador were …

items.Name: The Azurik Monarchy II
items.Description: The Azuriks ruled Myr as the tyrants they always were, forcing the citizens of their now expansive kingdom to worship Hecatieus, and suppressing all other faiths with the exception of that of Hespeth. In Sirion, citizens were routinely sacrificed in bizarre rituals to appease th…

items.Description: Elves, and humans with elven blood, are lithe and fair-skinned, and are often considered to be hauntingly beautiful in myth and legends. Indeed, most would agree that elves and half-elves have a particularly high proportion of beautiful people. Just as attractive people have b…

items.Name: The Nature of Beauty II
items.Description:
It is important to realize that beauty is not dangerous in and of itself. Succubi are not inherently evil. Rather, they are unfortunate slaves to fiends of great evil.

  Celestials, also called angels, are the opposite of fiends. Just as the majority of fiends are grotesque a…

items.Name: The Legend of Casparum
items.Description: To this day, expeditions to search for the ruins of Casparum in the deserts of Khazerun have failed. Historians have reason to believe that the rich city did once exist, pointing out ancient scrolls, pottery, and tools found scattered about the area where the city was once thoug…

items.Name: Elf & Dwarf War
items.Description: While most elves and dwarves of the the younger generations have put aside their differences to coexist in peace, it is a commonly known fact that their cultures have a historical mutual dislike of eachother. This tension dates back to the Elf & Dwarf War that began six hundred …

items.Name: The City of Underworlds
items.Description:
The City of Underworlds, officially called Thenopolis, lies along the west shores of the River Thenis in central Sansabar. To the north are the Ivory Mountains, to the east is Valenza and the road to Myr, and to the west is the mage city of Tembra. 

Thenopolis was founded nearl…

items.Name: Bestiary of Trolls I
items.Description:
Among the most feared and horrid carnivores in the history of Arterra is the troll. These creatures have terrorized people dating back to our earliest records, yet our knowledge of them remains limited because of the difficulty in studying them, and because of their variety.

…

items.Name: Bestiary of Trolls II
items.Description: Trolls are among the most voracious of carnivores because of a ceaseless hunger. They will eat anything from grubs to meat, preferring fresh red meat above all else. Because they are too slow to catch skittish prey such as deer, a troll's diet is likely to consist of boar, bea…

items.Name: Witches
items.Description:
For as long as civilization has existed, mothers have told their children stories about witches and what they do to naughty children. The question that most of us have never had answered is this: do witches exist?

  The answer is yes and no. Witches do not fly around on broom…

items.Name: Mithril Large Shield
items.Description: This flawless shield is among the finest examples of the dwarven forge. Its mithril frame is light and thin, yet even the mightiest blows cannot scratch its smooth surface, nor can age tarnish the glimmer of its polish. Engraved at its center is the emblem of Amridell.

items.Description: Romadon axes have a wicked point on the end of their blades to inflict further damage on opponents.

items.Description: Romadon swords are heavy weapons that can be wielded with one or both hands, and have serrated edges to inflict further damage to its victims.

items.Name: Azoril's Nail
items.Description: Azoril, the god of war, has no preferred weapon like other gods. His Nail is a spear with his signature permanent coating of acid. The only other common theme with Azoril's weapons is that they are always medium-sized or larger, and they are always melee weapons.

items.Name: Thunder and Lightning
items.Description: A signature weapon of Tarsus the Stormlord, this bow seems to channel the fury of the skies. Neither truly good nor truly evil, the devout of Tarsus have made few marks in Arterran history, a good thing considering the power of the gifts of the Stormlord.

items.Name: Tianara's Sword
items.Description: Coated with the signature acid of Azoril, this black-handled twin-bladed sword is otherwise far more effective than any of the God of War's weapons. It never dulls, nor does it ever stain, and judging by the way it cuts through steel, it is likely unbreakable.

items.Name: Mace of the Unholy
items.Description: The smooth, dark metal of this mace never shines no matter the lighting, as though it snuffs out light itself. items.Name: Valenur's Decree
items.Description: This golden-hilted sword burns with the wrath of Valenur. It is said that the God of Justice gifted it to Sir Faldor when he declared him his Chosen and set him on the path of righteous justice.

items.Name: Vampire Fang
items.Description: Legends speak of a weapon that has absorbed the essence of a powerful vampire. They say that the weapon whispers thoughts of bloodlust to the owner, slowly taking over the owner's mind until all that's left is pure evil.

items.Name: Crossbow of Veracity
items.Description: Employed by the dwarven snipers of Volkern, these crossbows have been instrumental in turning aside two orc invasions in the last century. The original design was even more powerful, but most were destroyed in a black dragon invasion of the dwarven kingdom 150 years ago.

items.Name: Vex
items.Description: This is one of a pair of blades wielded by an infamous bandit known only as Razor, who terrorized the trade routes between Tembra and Valenza.
